MODULE_CONTRACT.refs: REQ32-API REQ32-LIMITS REQ32-AUTH REQ36-WAKE-TOKEN INV32-ONE-API DP36-F01 DP36-F05
MODULE_CONTRACT.INTENT: Expose the single protected HTTP resource tree for conversation operations and translate requests and domain outcomes at the transport boundary.

RESPONSIBILITIES.RESPONSIBILITY: Accept only routes within the unversioned /conversations tree, validate request shape and documented size limits before side effects, dispatch protected wakeToken-resolution requests to the server-side wakeToken module and other operations to their responsible modules, and map outcomes to HTTP responses.

NON_RESPONSIBILITIES.RULE: Do not authenticate sessions, make membership or visibility decisions, mutate domain state directly, publish realtime events, or introduce /v1 or /v2 conversation aliases.

MODULE_CONTRACT.INPUTS: HTTP requests and transport-level request metadata for the approved /conversations resource tree.
MODULE_CONTRACT.OUTPUTS: HTTP responses representing validation, authentication, authorization, domain, conflict, availability, or successful outcomes without exposing protected data on failure.

DEPENDENCIES.DEPENDENCY: Server-side resolution of the submitted wakeToken through the existing protected Chat API.

MODULE_CONTRACT.STATE_EFFECTS: None directly. Domain state changes occur only through the owning domain or persistence boundary after required validation and authorization.

SIDE_EFFECTS.ALLOWED: Return an HTTP response for the requested operation.
SIDE_EFFECTS.FORBIDDEN: Perform protected writes before validation and authorization, disclose internal credentials, or route a request to a legacy/versioned conversation API.

PRECONDITIONS.CONDITION: The request targets the approved resource tree and passes transport-level parsing and size validation before dispatch.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: Exactly one conversation HTTP resource tree is exposed; a rejected request produces no protected domain mutation.

MODULE_CONTRACT.FAILURE_BEHAVIOR: Reject malformed or oversized requests before side effects. Map downstream failures without leaking protected conversation, message, token, endpoint, or credential data.

MODULE_CONTRACT.refs: REQ32-AUTH REQ32-ISOLATION INV32-DPOP TECH36-INTERNAL-AUTH DP36-F01 DP36-F04 DP36-F05
MODULE_CONTRACT.INTENT: Establish the authenticated BFE caller context for each protected Chat API request using the existing authentication boundary.

RESPONSIBILITIES.RESPONSIBILITY: Validate the BFE Drive session and session-bound DPoP proof through existing Internal Auth over UDS for each protected request, and provide the authenticated account/session context to Chat policy.

NON_RESPONSIBILITIES.RULE: Do not infer Chat membership from an account UUID or BFE Drive administrative status, accept plain Bearer as a substitute for DPoP, or treat a wakeToken or push subscription as identity.

MODULE_CONTRACT.INPUTS: Protected-request authentication material, DPoP proof, and request binding required by the existing Internal Auth boundary.
MODULE_CONTRACT.OUTPUTS: Validated caller/session context, or an authentication failure that does not disclose protected Chat data.

DEPENDENCIES.DEPENDENCY: Existing BFE Drive Internal Auth over UDS.

MODULE_CONTRACT.STATE_EFFECTS: No Chat domain state changes. Authentication and DPoP validation are performed for each protected request rather than inherited from an earlier request.

SIDE_EFFECTS.FORBIDDEN: Grant membership, mutate conversation state, or log secrets, full proofs, access tokens, or push credentials.

PRECONDITIONS.CONDITION: The protected operation supplies authentication material that can be validated by the existing Internal Auth boundary.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: Only a validated session-bound caller context is supplied to policy; invalid, absent, replayed, or misbound proof fails closed.

MODULE_CONTRACT.FAILURE_BEHAVIOR: Reject the request without protected-data side effects when authentication or DPoP validation fails or the existing Internal Auth boundary is unavailable.

MODULE_CONTRACT.refs: REQ32-AUTH REQ32-MEMBERSHIP REQ32-HISTORY REQ32-ROLES REQ36-WAKE-TOKEN REQ36-CHAT-STATE INV32-DPOP INV36-WAKE-TOKEN DP36-D04 DP36-F01 DP36-F03 DP36-F05 DP36-F06 DP36-F07 DP36-F08
MODULE_CONTRACT.INTENT: Make current, operation-specific authorization decisions for Chat resources and messages.

RESPONSIBILITIES.RESPONSIBILITY: Evaluate validated caller identity, current membership and role, membership visibility intervals, and per-message visibility for each protected operation, including history retrieval and wakeToken resolution.

NON_RESPONSIBILITIES.RULE: Do not treat account UUID, push receipt, topic possession, or possession of a wakeToken as authorization; do not reuse a previous authorization result in place of checking current rights.

MODULE_CONTRACT.INPUTS: Validated caller/session context, operation/resource context, current Chat state, and current membership and visibility state.
MODULE_CONTRACT.OUTPUTS: An allow/deny decision scoped to the requested operation and currently visible data.

DEPENDENCIES.DEPENDENCY: Authoritative current membership, roles, and visibility intervals through the conversation domain module, per DP36-D04.

MODULE_CONTRACT.STATE_EFFECTS: No domain state changes. Evaluates current state for each protected operation.

SIDE_EFFECTS.FORBIDDEN: Grant access from stale membership, expose whether a denied token maps to an existing conversation, or bypass visibility intervals.

PRECONDITIONS.CONDITION: Identity has been validated for this request and the authoritative state needed for the decision can be read.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: Only currently authorized resources and messages are allowed; removal or visibility-interval boundaries apply immediately to subsequent protected operations.

MODULE_CONTRACT.FAILURE_BEHAVIOR: Deny access if identity, current availability, membership, role, or visibility cannot be established. Return no protected content or conversation identity on denial.

MODULE_CONTRACT.refs: REQ32-MODEL REQ32-DIRECT REQ32-GROUP REQ32-ROLES REQ32-MEMBERSHIP REQ32-PRESERVE INV32-PRESERVE DP36-F03 DP36-F07 DP36-TX-MEMBERSHIP
MODULE_CONTRACT.INTENT: Own the direct/group conversation domain and its membership and role transitions.

RESPONSIBILITIES.RESPONSIBILITY: Maintain stable shared conversation identity; enforce unique, concurrency-safe direct pairs; enforce group member limits, owner/admin/member rules, exactly one group owner, ownership transfer and departure rules, caller-only personal hide; serialize membership changes and maintain bounded visibility intervals.

NON_RESPONSIBILITIES.RULE: Do not authenticate external sessions, make push delivery decisions, copy document content, or grant BFE Drive document rights.

MODULE_CONTRACT.INPUTS: Authorized direct/group domain commands and the validated caller context plus current domain state.
MODULE_CONTRACT.OUTPUTS: Domain outcomes and committed conversation, role, membership, or visibility-interval state.
MODULE_CONTRACT.STATE_EFFECTS: Creates or updates conversation identity, membership, role, ownership, personal hide, and bounded membership visibility intervals under the approved transaction ordering.

SIDE_EFFECTS.ALLOWED: Commit an authorized domain mutation and its corresponding visibility boundary atomically.
SIDE_EFFECTS.FORBIDDEN: Partially apply a membership/role mutation or leave a successful group operation without exactly one owner.

PRECONDITIONS.CONDITION: The caller is authenticated and current policy authorizes the requested operation; inputs satisfy the requirements' domain limits.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: Successful operations preserve direct-pair uniqueness, group ownership/role rules, and auditable bounded membership visibility intervals. Failed operations leave no partial domain mutation.

MODULE_CONTRACT.FAILURE_BEHAVIOR: Reject invalid role transitions, self-direct creation, duplicate/conflicting operations, and invalid ownership departure without partial writes. Preserve existing domain state on transaction failure.

MODULE_CONTRACT.refs: REQ32-MESSAGE REQ32-DOCUMENT REQ32-REALTIME REQ32-LIMITS REQ32-MEMBERSHIP INV32-PRESERVE TD36-DELIVERY-FAILURE DP36-F02 DP36-TX-MESSAGE
MODULE_CONTRACT.INTENT: Validate and persist a message in the authorized conversation while preserving ordering, document metadata, and idempotency semantics.

RESPONSIBILITIES.RESPONSIBILITY: Derive sender identity from the validated caller, require current membership, validate message and request limits, retain optional document ID/title as message metadata when present, allocate conversation-scoped order, and preserve the idempotency result.

NON_RESPONSIBILITIES.RULE: Do not accept trusted sender identity from the client, copy document content, grant BFE Drive document rights, include document metadata in realtime payloads, or roll back a committed message after push failure.

MODULE_CONTRACT.INPUTS: Authorized message content, optional document context metadata, idempotency key, and validated caller/conversation context.
MODULE_CONTRACT.OUTPUTS: The persisted message and its original idempotent result, including conversation-scoped order and optional document metadata.

DEPENDENCIES.DEPENDENCY: Atomic message, order, and idempotency persistence.

MODULE_CONTRACT.STATE_EFFECTS: Persists one logical message, optional document ID/title metadata, conversation order, and idempotency outcome within the approved message transaction.

SIDE_EFFECTS.ALLOWED: Initiate realtime notification only after message persistence has committed.
SIDE_EFFECTS.FORBIDDEN: Persist document content, publish before commit, duplicate a logical message/notification on idempotent replay, or roll back persisted history due to delivery failure.

PRECONDITIONS.CONDITION: The caller is authenticated, currently authorized to send in the conversation, and the request satisfies message and payload limits.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: Successful persistence yields one ordered logical message and a stable idempotency result. Identical replay returns the original result; replay with different content is a conflict. Any notification attempt follows commit.

MODULE_CONTRACT.FAILURE_BEHAVIOR: Reject invalid or unauthorized messages before writes. On persistence failure, do not publish. On push failure after commit, retain the message and leave history as the recovery path.

MODULE_CONTRACT.refs: REQ32-HISTORY REQ32-DOCUMENT REQ32-READ REQ32-MEMBERSHIP REQ32-AUTH AC32-DOCUMENT INV32-PRESERVE DP36-F05 DP36-F06 DP36-TX-READ-MARKER
MODULE_CONTRACT.INTENT: Serve authorized message history and read state, including catch-up after missed wake events.

RESPONSIBILITIES.RESPONSIBILITY: Return cursor-paginated messages in stable conversation order filtered by current membership visibility intervals; include document ID/title only when present in the stored message context of a visible message; maintain monotonically increasing per-account/per-conversation read markers and authorized unread semantics.

NON_RESPONSIBILITIES.RULE: Do not infer message availability from push receipts, return messages or metadata outside the caller's visibility interval, copy document content, or grant BFE Drive document rights. BFE Drive independently checks access to the referenced document.

MODULE_CONTRACT.INPUTS: Authenticated history/catch-up query, cursor and page limit, or authorized read-marker operation.
MODULE_CONTRACT.OUTPUTS: Visible message pages and cursor state, or caller-scoped read marker/unread state.

DEPENDENCIES.DEPENDENCY: Current caller authorization and visibility filtering.
Authoritative message, membership interval, and read-marker state.

MODULE_CONTRACT.STATE_EFFECTS: History reads do not mutate message content. An authorized read-marker update may advance only the caller's marker monotonically.

SIDE_EFFECTS.ALLOWED: Advance the authenticated caller's own read marker when the operation authorizes it.
SIDE_EFFECTS.FORBIDDEN: Advance another account's marker, return hidden-gap messages after rejoin, or expose document metadata from a message the caller cannot view.

PRECONDITIONS.CONDITION: The request has a valid session-bound DPoP context, and current membership/visibility is evaluated for the requested history or read operation. No application-level Chat-state gate is consulted.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: Only currently visible messages and their optional document metadata are returned; catch-up uses persisted history as authoritative state; read markers remain monotonic and caller-scoped.

MODULE_CONTRACT.FAILURE_BEHAVIOR: Deny or filter inaccessible history without revealing hidden message content, document metadata, or conversation identity. Reject invalid cursors/limits and unauthorized read-marker updates without protected side effects.

MODULE_CONTRACT.refs: TECH36-POSTGRESQL TECH36-PGX TECH36-GOOSE TD36-DATA-AND-ACCESS REQ32-PRESERVE REQ32-DOCUMENT INV32-PRESERVE INV32-NO-LEGACY DP36-TX-MESSAGE DP36-TX-MEMBERSHIP DP36-TX-TOKEN DP36-TX-READ-MARKER DP36-TX-SUBSCRIPTION
MODULE_CONTRACT.INTENT: Provide the authoritative PostgreSQL persistence and transaction boundaries for Chat-owned state.

RESPONSIBILITIES.RESPONSIBILITY: Persist and query conversation/domain state, bounded membership visibility intervals, ordered messages and optional document ID/title metadata, idempotency outcomes, read markers, protected UnifiedPush subscription data, and durable wakeToken mappings.

NON_RESPONSIBILITIES.RULE: Do not independently decide authorization, store document content, grant BFE Drive document rights, migrate legacy production data, or make external ntfy publication part of a database transaction.

MODULE_CONTRACT.INPUTS: Authorized domain persistence requests and queries with the transaction/order requirements of the owning module.
MODULE_CONTRACT.OUTPUTS: Committed state or query results from PostgreSQL, with transaction failures surfaced to the owning module.

DEPENDENCIES.DEPENDENCY: Approved PostgreSQL access and transaction library.
Approved schema migration tooling; this contract does not authorize a migration operation.

MODULE_CONTRACT.STATE_EFFECTS: Owns durable Chat data listed in the approved architecture. Membership mutation and visibility boundary, message ordering and idempotency, token mapping, read-marker, and subscription updates respect their corresponding DP36 transaction boundaries.

SIDE_EFFECTS.ALLOWED: Commit or roll back local PostgreSQL transactions.
SIDE_EFFECTS.FORBIDDEN: Perform external push delivery within a database transaction, change upstream requirements/technology, or introduce legacy compatibility state.

PRECONDITIONS.CONDITION: The caller module has passed the required authorization and supplies a persistence operation consistent with the approved transaction boundary.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: Committed state is authoritative for history, membership visibility, idempotency, read state, subscription state, and token mapping; failed transactions do not expose partial state.

MODULE_CONTRACT.FAILURE_BEHAVIOR: Propagate database/transaction failure without claiming success. Do not publish notifications for an uncommitted message. Do not convert a failed write into an authorization success.

MODULE_CONTRACT.refs: TD36-REGISTRATION TD36-NTFY-ACL REQ32-AUTH REQ36-NOTIFICATION REQ36-CHAT-STATE INV36-CHAT-STATE DP36-F04 DP36-TX-SUBSCRIPTION
MODULE_CONTRACT.INTENT: Manage an authenticated account's UnifiedPush delivery destination without granting conversation or history access.

RESPONSIBILITIES.RESPONSIBILITY: Register, replace, and remove the endpoint, public encryption key, and authentication secret associated with the authenticated BFE account through the protected API; persist subscription state only after identity and endpoint validation, with storage/transport health handled through dependency failures.

NON_RESPONSIBILITIES.RULE: A subscription is only a delivery destination. Do not create membership, grant history access, provision broader ntfy permissions, or expose ntfy administrative credentials to BFE Chat or clients.

MODULE_CONTRACT.INPUTS: Authenticated registration/replacement/removal request and the UnifiedPush endpoint plus associated encryption material returned by the registration flow.
MODULE_CONTRACT.OUTPUTS: Accepted or rejected subscription state for the authenticated account; secret values are not returned to other accounts or written to logs.
MODULE_CONTRACT.STATE_EFFECTS: Creates, replaces, or removes the authenticated account's protected subscription record within the approved subscription transaction boundary.

SIDE_EFFECTS.ALLOWED: Persist protected endpoint and encryption material associated with the authenticated account.
SIDE_EFFECTS.FORBIDDEN: Log endpoint capabilities, auth secrets, full payloads, wakeToken values, or ntfy administrative credentials; broaden ACLs beyond TD36-NTFY-ACL.

PRECONDITIONS.CONDITION: Caller authentication is valid and endpoint security accepts the configured ntfy destination origin.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: Only the authenticated account's subscription state is changed; the subscription grants no Chat membership or history access.

MODULE_CONTRACT.FAILURE_BEHAVIOR: Reject invalid, out-of-origin, non-HTTPS, or redirected endpoints. Dependency failure does not create a partially accepted subscription.

MODULE_CONTRACT.refs: TD36-ENDPOINT-SECURITY REQ32-AUTH REQ32-ISOLATION DP36-F04
MODULE_CONTRACT.INTENT: Constrain outbound push delivery to the configured ntfy server origin and prevent arbitrary endpoint selection.

RESPONSIBILITIES.RESPONSIBILITY: Require HTTPS and an origin matching the configured ntfy server; reject invalid schemes, arbitrary client-supplied hosts, redirects, and any origin outside the configured server before the endpoint is accepted or used.

NON_RESPONSIBILITIES.RULE: Do not introduce an allowlist expansion, arbitrary webhook delivery, a second push server, or an endpoint override that lets client input choose the destination origin.

MODULE_CONTRACT.INPUTS: A UnifiedPush endpoint value and the configured ntfy server origin.
MODULE_CONTRACT.OUTPUTS: An endpoint accepted under the configured-origin rule or a rejection.

DEPENDENCIES.DEPENDENCY: The approved ntfy server is the only allowed destination origin.

MODULE_CONTRACT.STATE_EFFECTS: No persistent state changes. Supplies a validation result before subscription persistence or outbound delivery.

SIDE_EFFECTS.FORBIDDEN: Make requests to arbitrary or redirected destinations or allow user-controlled endpoint values to expand the configured origin.

PRECONDITIONS.CONDITION: The configured ntfy origin is authoritative and the candidate endpoint is available for validation.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: Any endpoint accepted for registration or delivery is HTTPS and bound to the configured ntfy origin.

MODULE_CONTRACT.FAILURE_BEHAVIOR: Reject the endpoint before persistence or network use when its scheme, origin, host, or redirect behavior violates the approved rule. Fail closed when validation cannot establish the configured origin.

MODULE_CONTRACT.refs: REQ36-WAKE-TOKEN REQ32-AUTH REQ32-MEMBERSHIP REQ36-CHAT-STATE INV36-WAKE-TOKEN INV36-CHAT-STATE TD36-TOKEN DP36-F02 DP36-F05 DP36-F07 DP36-F08 DP36-TX-TOKEN
MODULE_CONTRACT.INTENT: Maintain a durable opaque reference from issued wake notifications to their associated conversation and resolve it only inside the protected authorization boundary.

RESPONSIBILITIES.RESPONSIBILITY: Generate wakeToken using the approved cryptographic random source, persist its conversation mapping, retain the mapping while issued notifications may still be delivered, queued, retried, or activated, and allow repeated resolution without consuming the token.

NON_RESPONSIBILITIES.RULE: Do not assign an arbitrary fixed TTL, consume or invalidate a token on successful use, treat possession as authorization, or disclose conversation identity when resolution fails.

MODULE_CONTRACT.INPUTS: Token creation associated with an authorized conversation notification and a protected token-resolution request carrying the token.
MODULE_CONTRACT.OUTPUTS: A durable token-to-conversation mapping for publication, or a resolved conversation reference only after current access checks succeed.

DEPENDENCIES.DEPENDENCY: Current session-bound DPoP identity for resolution.
Current membership and visibility decision on each resolution.

MODULE_CONTRACT.STATE_EFFECTS: Creates durable mapping state; resolution is read-only and does not consume, rotate, or invalidate the token.

SIDE_EFFECTS.ALLOWED: Persist a mapping before its token is published.
SIDE_EFFECTS.FORBIDDEN: Publish an unmapped token, delete a mapping based on an arbitrary TTL, or return protected data on failed authorization.

PRECONDITIONS.CONDITION: Token issuance is associated with a valid conversation notification path. Resolution is requested through the protected Chat API with current identity validation.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: The mapping exists before publication and remains while old notifications may be processed; every resolution independently checks current authorization and fails closed after revocation; service/dependency failures follow the public error contract.

MODULE_CONTRACT.FAILURE_BEHAVIOR: Return a non-disclosing failure for invalid, unknown, or unauthorized tokens. If mapping persistence fails, do not publish the token. If access was revoked, retain no authorization derived from earlier delivery.

MODULE_CONTRACT.refs: REQ32-REALTIME REQ32-DOCUMENT REQ32-MEMBERSHIP REQ36-WAKE-TOKEN REQ36-NOTIFICATION INV36-OPAQUE-WAKE INV36-WAKE-TOKEN TD36-TRANSPORT TD36-WEBPUSH TD36-PAYLOAD TD36-NTFY-ACL TD36-DELIVERY-FAILURE TECH36-INTEROP-CHECK DP36-D09 DP36-F02 DP36-F07 DP36-F08 DP36-GATE-INTEROP DP36-TX-DELIVERY-OUTBOX DP36-ST-PUSH-DISPATCHING DP36-ST-PUSH-UNKNOWN DP36-ST-PUSH-UNKNOWN-DISPATCHING DP36-ST-PUSH-UNKNOWN-AMBIGUOUS DP36-MT17 DP36-MT18 DP36-MT19 DP36-MT20 DP36-MT21 DP36-MT22
MODULE_CONTRACT.INTENT: Emit a minimal post-commit wake signal over the sole approved realtime transport, without making delivery an authorization mechanism or part of message persistence.

RESPONSIBILITIES.RESPONSIBILITY: After message commit, determine currently eligible recipients excluding the sender, recheck eligibility, ensure a durable wakeToken mapping, and prepare only the approved encrypted payload. Claim the outbox intent with attempt_id, worker_id and a ten-second lease renewed every three seconds. Before HTTP, atomically obtain a one-time dispatch_permit_id while the lease is valid and transition ATTEMPTED to DISPATCHING. The permit remains valid after the original lease expires; the permit-owning existing backend worker makes one HTTP attempt and records the result against the permit identity. A DISPATCHING attempt can be recovered to UNKNOWN only after a trusted existing process-lifecycle source confirms the exact worker process instance terminated.

NON_RESPONSIBILITIES.RULE: Do not include message text, conversation/account identifiers, document IDs/titles, or document content in the wake payload; do not use Centrifuge, WebSocket, or another parallel realtime transport; do not expose ntfy administrative credentials.

MODULE_CONTRACT.INPUTS: A committed message, authorized-recipient eligibility, a registered endpoint with approved encryption material, and a durable wakeToken mapping.
MODULE_CONTRACT.OUTPUTS: A single permit-authorized publication attempt carrying the exact allowlisted encrypted payload and a terminal outcome recorded without secrets.

DEPENDENCIES.DEPENDENCY: Committed message and transaction boundary; external dispatch begins only after commit, per DP36-D09.
UnifiedPush distributor and Android connector path.

MODULE_CONTRACT.STATE_EFFECTS: External publication is post-commit. Outbox states progress QUEUED to ATTEMPTED and then either UNKNOWN before permit grant or DISPATCHING after permit grant; the permit-bound result becomes PUSH_DELIVERED, PUSH_FAILED or UNKNOWN. Lease expiry does not revoke a committed permit or recover DISPATCHING. Message and token mapping state are never rolled back.

SIDE_EFFECTS.ALLOWED: Publish one encrypted minimal wake payload only through the egress-dispatch path after a committed one-time permit; record a sanitized outcome bound to that permit.
SIDE_EFFECTS.FORBIDDEN: Publish without a permit, publish more than once for an intent, let lease expiry revoke a committed permit, recover DISPATCHING solely from lease expiry, publish before message commit, notify the sender, emit duplicate logical notifications for idempotent replay, or widen the approved ntfy ACL.

PRECONDITIONS.CONDITION: The message is committed, recipient eligibility has been rechecked, the endpoint passes origin validation, the token mapping is durable, and the matching ATTEMPTED row has an unexpired lease when the one-time permit is granted.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: The payload contains exactly protocol version and opaque wakeToken; sender is excluded; one committed permit authorizes at most one HTTP attempt. Outcome writes require matching delivery, attempt, worker, permit and worker identity. The permit survives lease expiry; DISPATCHING is never recovered by timer; it may transition to UNKNOWN only after trusted confirmation that the worker process has terminated. If no such confirmation is available, leave DISPATCHING unchanged indefinitely. Replays do not create a duplicate logical notification.

MODULE_CONTRACT.FAILURE_BEHAVIOR: Before permit grant, lease expiry or recovery to UNKNOWN prevents HTTP. After permit grant, lease expiry alone does not revoke the permit; the bound worker process may finish its one request. A timeout or ambiguous result becomes UNKNOWN. If the worker process terminates without a result, recovery requires trusted confirmation that the exact instance terminated; while it may still resume, leave DISPATCHING unchanged. No automatic retry. Missed updates are recovered through authenticated history. Runtime interoperability remains unverified until DP36-GATE-INTEROP passes.

MODULE_CONTRACT.refs: TECH36-UP-ANDROID TECH36-NTFY-ANDROID TD36-ANDROID-NOTIFICATION REQ32-REALTIME REQ32-DOCUMENT REQ36-NOTIFICATION INV36-OPAQUE-WAKE TD36-PAYLOAD DP36-F05 DP36-GATE-INTEROP
MODULE_CONTRACT.INTENT: Receive the approved UnifiedPush wake payload on Android and create a generic system notification that does not disclose protected content.

RESPONSIBILITIES.RESPONSIBILITY: Accept only protocol version and opaque wakeToken fields in the wake payload, keep only those fields in internal notification navigation state, and request the Android system to display a generic notification.

NON_RESPONSIBILITIES.RULE: Do not put message text, conversation/account identifiers, document IDs/titles, or document content into the push payload, visible notification text, or an activation URL. Do not treat receipt as permission to read history.

MODULE_CONTRACT.INPUTS: The decrypted application payload delivered through the approved ntfy UnifiedPush distributor and Android connector.
MODULE_CONTRACT.OUTPUTS: A generic Android system notification with internal activation state limited to protocol version and opaque wakeToken, or no actionable notification for an invalid payload.

DEPENDENCIES.DEPENDENCY: Approved ntfy Android distributor and UnifiedPush connector.
Activation resolves the opaque wakeToken only through the protected API.

MODULE_CONTRACT.STATE_EFFECTS: Creates local system-notification state; no Chat domain state is changed and no conversation identity is trusted from the payload.

SIDE_EFFECTS.ALLOWED: Display a generic notification and retain the minimal internal activation fields.
SIDE_EFFECTS.FORBIDDEN: Expose protected metadata in visible text or navigate directly to a conversation based on unvalidated payload data.

PRECONDITIONS.CONDITION: The event was delivered through the approved UnifiedPush path and its application payload can be validated against the exact allowlist.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: A valid payload can trigger a generic notification only; authorization and history access remain server-side operations performed after activation.

MODULE_CONTRACT.FAILURE_BEHAVIOR: Reject or ignore malformed or non-allowlisted payloads without exposing their contents or opening a conversation. Runtime behavior remains subject to the unverified interoperability gate.

MODULE_CONTRACT.refs: REQ36-NOTIFICATION REQ36-WAKE-TOKEN REQ32-AUTH REQ32-HISTORY INV36-OPAQUE-WAKE INV36-WAKE-TOKEN INV36-CHAT-STATE DP36-D12 DP36-D13 DP36-F05 DP36-F08
MODULE_CONTRACT.INTENT: Resolve a notification's opaque wakeToken through the protected Chat API before opening a conversation and retrieving history.

RESPONSIBILITIES.RESPONSIBILITY: On activation, send the opaque wakeToken to the existing protected Chat API using the current session-bound DPoP request context; navigate only to the conversation returned after successful server-side token resolution, then request history through the protected API.

NON_RESPONSIBILITIES.RULE: Do not resolve the wakeToken locally, perform server-side DPoP validation or authorization, evaluate membership/message visibility, filter server history, derive a conversation ID from notification payload, navigate before successful resolution, or disclose whether a failed token belongs to an existing conversation.

MODULE_CONTRACT.INPUTS: Notification activation state containing only protocol version and opaque wakeToken, plus the current client session used to issue the existing protected Chat API request with session-bound DPoP.
MODULE_CONTRACT.OUTPUTS: Authorized conversation navigation followed by history retrieval, or a non-disclosing failure with no protected data exposure.

DEPENDENCIES.DEPENDENCY: Protected wakeToken resolution and current-policy recheck, per DP36-D12.
Authorized history catch-up after successful token resolution, per DP36-D13.

MODULE_CONTRACT.STATE_EFFECTS: May change local navigation state only after successful protected resolution. Does not change server-side token or conversation state.

SIDE_EFFECTS.ALLOWED: Open the resolved conversation and request currently visible history after authorization succeeds.
SIDE_EFFECTS.FORBIDDEN: Open a conversation or fetch protected history after invalid token, revoked membership, or invalid DPoP.

PRECONDITIONS.CONDITION: The activation is initiated from a notification carrying only the approved wake payload fields and the current client session is available for validation.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: Successful activation opens only the conversation resolved by the protected API and retrieves history filtered by current visibility. Failure reveals no conversation identity or message content.

MODULE_CONTRACT.FAILURE_BEHAVIOR: Keep the client away from the target conversation when token resolution or authorization fails. Do not retry by falling back to an identifier from notification data.

SEQUENCE.STEP: Validate route, request shape, and limits before side effects.
Validate the current session-bound DPoP proof through Internal Auth over UDS.
Check current operation-specific rights and visibility.
Execute the authorized domain operation.
Commit only the authorized state change.

INTERACTION_CONTRACT.FAILURE_OUTCOME: Any failed prerequisite stops the protected operation; no protected write or data disclosure occurs on a rejected path.

Within one database transaction, serialize against membership changes, allocate conversation-scoped order, persist the message and optional document ID/title metadata plus the idempotency result, and define the eligible-recipient snapshot. Do not persist document content.
Commit before any external push attempt.
Ensure the opaque token mapping is durable before its token can be published.

Provide the registered delivery endpoint and associated encryption material for each eligible recipient; subscription state does not grant conversation membership or history access.

DP36-M-REALTIME organizes publication of the encrypted payload through DP36-X-NTFY on the approved ntfy and UnifiedPush path.
After the publication attempt, record a sanitized delivery outcome without secrets.

INTERACTION_CONTRACT.FAILURE_OUTCOME: A delivery or token-mapping failure after message commit does not roll back the message. No token is published before its mapping is durable. Identical idempotent replay creates no duplicate logical notification; history is the recovery path.

Check current availability and role permissions.
Apply the authorized membership or ownership transition and bounded visibility interval.
Commit domain state and visibility boundary atomically.

INTERACTION_CONTRACT.FAILURE_OUTCOME: Invalid role transitions or transaction failure leave no partial membership/ownership mutation. Later history and token resolution observe the committed visibility boundary.

SEQUENCE.STEP: Validate the current session-bound DPoP proof.
Require HTTPS and the configured ntfy origin; reject arbitrary hosts and redirects.
Accept only the destination and encryption material returned by the registration flow.
Persist account-scoped subscription data under the approved transaction boundary.

INTERACTION_CONTRACT.FAILURE_OUTCOME: Failed authentication, endpoint validation, or persistence does not create an accepted subscription and never widens ntfy ACLs.

Evaluate current membership and visibility intervals for the caller.
Read ordered message records and relevant read state.

On each subsequent resolution, revalidate current membership and fail closed.
Deny or interval-filter history without exposing hidden messages or conversation identity.
